title: A minimal hypercone with the Hardy-type inequality (3), 2 ≤ m ≤ 6, has vanishing second fundamental form (end of the proof of Simon B.2)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ with 2 ≤ m ≤ 6, A₀ ⊆ ℝ^P a subspace with dim A₀ = m + 1, M ⊆ A₀ with 0 ∉ M, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M for every r ∈ ℕ, closure(M) ⊆ M ∪ {0}, tx ∈ M for x ∈ M and t > 0, H^m(M ∩ K) < ∞ for compact K; let ν : ℝ^P → ℝ^P be C^∞ on some open O ⊇ M, with ν(x) ∈ A₀, |ν(x)| = 1 and ν(x)·v = 0 for every v ∈ tangentSpace M x, for every x ∈ M. Assume density one: for every z ∈ M, H^m(M ∩ B_s(z))/(ω_m s^m) → 1 as s ↓ 0 (ω_m = unitBallVolume m); and (H3): 2∫_M ψ²|A|²/|x|² dH^m ≤ ∫_M |A|²·Σ_j(δ_jψ)² dH^m for every ψ locally Lipschitz on M vanishing on M outside a compact subset of M. Throughout: P_y is the orthogonal projection onto span(tangentSpace M y), e_j = EuclideanSpace.single j 1, H^m = μHE[m], |A|²(y) := Σ_j |Dν(y)(P_ye_j)|² (Dν = fderiv ℝ ν), δ_jg(y) := fderivWithin ℝ g M y (P_ye_j). Then fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0 for every x ∈ M and every v ∈ tangentSpace M x.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (A₀ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (M : Set (Euclid P)) (ν : Euclid P → Euclid P), 2 ≤ m → m ≤ 6 → Module.finrank ℝ A₀ = m + 1 → M ⊆ (A₀ : Set (Euclid P)) → (0 : Euclid P) ∉ M → (∀ r : ℕ, IsEmbeddedSubmanifold r m M) → closure M ⊆ insert 0 M → (∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → ∀ x ∈ M, t • x ∈ M) → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → (∃ O : Set (Euclid P), IsOpen O ∧ M ⊆ O ∧ ContDiffOn ℝ (⊤ : ℕ∞) ν O) → (∀ x ∈ M, ν x ∈ A₀ ∧ ‖ν x‖ = 1 ∧ ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, inner ℝ (ν x) v = 0) → (∀ z ∈ M, Tendsto (fun s : ℝ => μHE[m] (M ∩ ball z s) / (unitBallVolume m * ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ m))) (𝓝[>] 0) (𝓝 1)) → (∀ ψ : Euclid P → ℝ, LocallyLipschitzOn M ψ → (∃ C : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact C ∧ C ⊆ M ∧ ∀ x ∈ M, x ∉ C → ψ x = 0) → 2 * (∫ x in M, ψ x ^ 2 * (∑ j : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))‖ ^ 2) / ‖x‖ ^ 2 ∂μHE[m]) ≤ ∫ x in M, (∑ j : Fin P, ‖fderiv ℝ ν x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))‖ ^ 2) * (∑ j : Fin P, (fderivWithin ℝ ψ M x ((Submodule.span ℝ (tangentSpace M x)).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single j 1))) ^ 2) ∂μHE[m]) → ∀ x ∈ M, ∀ v ∈ tangentSpace M x, fderiv ℝ ν x v = 0
